title: place-names-floods: analysis code, frozen protocol and lexicon for a pre-specified test of whether the names of nearby settlements improve terrain-based predictions of river flood extent
description: Analysis code, frozen protocol (docs/protocol/preregistration_v2.md) with an English translation and its amendments, frozen multilingual lexicon, coded etymology excerpts and figure generator for the study 'Do the names of nearby settlements improve terrain-based predictions of mapped river flood extent? A pooled test at 250 m in 500 flood areas' (R. Okauchi and P.-J. Chun). PROVENANCE.md gives the freeze record and the checksums that verify the frozen files. The derived data (cell tables, language-model name readings, held-out predictions and run summaries) are archived in a separate Zenodo record.
